reviews.title: Doesn’t fit
reviews.text: I have an iPhone 5s, max iOS is 12. I have been looking for a pedometer that was iOS-12 friendly. And not full of ads, distractions, options, etc. Just a step counter. Thought I found it here but, sadly, no. When I opened it up it asked Male or Female. No problem there, but the “Continue” button (or “Next” or whatever) was just below the bottom of the screen so I could not click it. I can’t use this. Darn.
